carry_theorem.case_r_at_most_n: N<p, so every C(N,n-4k) and every complete summand is a p-unit
carry_theorem.complete_termwise_zero_classification: all summands are divisible by p iff d=0 and delta=2, equivalently r=n+1 and n=2 mod 4

carry_theorem.strict_scope: outside that ray at least one summand is a p-unit, but the total sum can still vanish by cancellation
carry_theorem.survivors: the surviving terms are exactly those with n-4k<=d

capacity_first.bulk_obstruction: outside zero-rate edge sets, r=Theta(M) and the surviving prefix length is Theta(M)
capacity_first.forced_termwise_ray: h=s odd gives at most one row at fixed M (M=7h+2), hence O(log M)=o(M)
capacity_first.low_rank_support: if 3r=o(M), then r=o(M), so the candidate-prime interval has length o(M) and weighted mass o(M)
capacity_first.short_interval_lemma: a fixed-M row set whose candidate primes lie in intervals of total length o(M) has weighted prime mass o(M), by the trivial bound below M/log^2 M and Brun-Titchmarsh above it
capacity_first.short_prefix_support: if the survivor length is o(M), then n=o(M) or positive d=r-n-1=o(M); each condition gives candidate-prime intervals of total length o(M)

minimal_recurrence.conclusion: the exact minimal homogeneous constant-coefficient recurrence order in n is 3r=6s+3
minimal_recurrence.reason: the numerator is 1, G(0)=1, and the leading coefficient of G is -4; hence for Q or F_p with p>2 the reduced denominator G^r has degree 3r
